newsitem.title: UK: Halma plans 1 for 3 capitalisation issue.
newsitem.headline: Halma plans 1 for 3 capitalisation issue.

text.p: British safety and environmental technology group Halma plc said on Tuesday it was recommending a capitalisation issue to shareholders of one ordinary share for every three ordinary shares held.
Halma announced its plans when it reported record pretax profit of 37.1 million stg for the year ended March 29.
Chairman David Barber noted that the company spent more than 20 million pounds in the year in question on acquisitions, all of which was paid for in cash.
"With only one minor exception arising from a prior commitment, it is now over three years since the group has issued any shares to fund acquisitions," Barber said.
